title: Forged in Fire
description:
S08 E32 — Judges Takeover: Doug Marcaida
Four smiths recreate a weapon from the mind of judge Doug Marcaida; the remaining two must recreate the Supersized Kortada.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E12 — Season Two Finale
The final four compete to determine the winner of the $100,000 prize and the title of Top Shot; the most-intense series of challenges of the competition takes place.

title: Top Shot
description:
S02 E13 — Behind the Bullet
The marksmen discuss their skills, strategies and most controversial shots.

title: Top Shot
description:
S03 E05 — Throwdown Showdown
The teams call each other out with primitive weapons; two shooters compete with the most powerful weapon ever used on "Top Shot."

title: Top Shot
description:
S03 E01 — The Gauntlet
A shoot off using one of the most powerful hand guns in history; a race where each team must carry a pole weighing over 200 pounds between eight foot tall firing platforms. An elimination challenge inspired by the stagecoaches of the old west.

title: Top Shot
description:
S03 E04 — The Bulldog Gatling
The legendary Gatling gun is introduced; team challenge with a historic pistol; two marksmen shoot it out.

title: Top Shot
description:
S03 E02 — Down and Dirty
Teams get down and dirty with the legendary AK-47; an extreme obstacle course with mud pits barbed wire and exploding mortars; two shooters face a friend or foe challenge with a military and police pistol.

title: Top Shot
description:
S03 E03 — Slug It Out
Shotgun skills are tested with a head-to-head speed shooting challenge; tension escalates on both teams; an elimination challenge unlike any before, featuring an elaborate machine, a Glock 34 and a line of non-stop cannonballs.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S01 E02 — Confederate Conundrum
A circa 1861 Civil War saber lands in the shop, but questions are raised about its authenticity; Fender guitar autographed by Chuck Berry; 1916 cash register.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E29 — The King's Bling
The guys are presented with a necklace once owned by Elvis Presley; a guy brings in a collection of over 200 vintage Matchbox cars; a man comes in with a pair of German Pickelhauben helmets from World War I.

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E20 — American Hero
A helicopter gunner helmet from the Vietnam War; 1948 Coca-Cola vending machine makeover.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E11 — Peacemaker
A 1890s Colt .45 peacemaker rides into the shop; Rick meets a man hoping to sell his photos of a Japanese Zero shot-down during World War II--in Alaska; a man brings in Elvis Presley's medical records.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E22 — Off the Wall
A man brings in a Civil War musket once carried by an ancestor wounded in battle; Corey sells an extremely rare movie poster from his personal collection; a rusted-out 1950s atomic missile-themed pedal car squeaks its way into the shop.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E33 — Teacher's Pet
The guys set their aim on a World War II bombsight; Corey and the Old Man check out a stock ticker from the 1930s; Chumlee teaches Antwaun about pawning.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E34 — Bugs Money
The team checks out a classic 1941 Indian motorcycle; a woman putters into the shop with a golf club once owned by Dean Martin; a seller arrives with a Bugs Bunny poster autographed by Mel Blanc.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E32 — Pirate's Booty
A street-legal pirate ship parade float cruises in; a woman drops in with a World War II bomber jacket and flight mission logs; Rick and the Old Man are presented with an antique carriage strong box.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E17 — Over the Top
A World War I helmet is brought into the shop; Corey and Rick are presented with a gun holster used on "Gunsmoke;" Rick decides the guys could use some exercise and hires them a personal trainer.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S04 E16 — Buy the Book
The team checks out a classic 1932 Lincoln roadster; a Civil War Confederate belt buckle walks into the shop; a man comes in hoping to sell his first edition copy of Ernest Hemingway's "For Whom the Bell Tolls."

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S06 E06 — Trigger Happy
A rare three-trigger Stevens shotgun is brought into the shop; Corey and Rick are presented with a movie camera used by the U.S. military during WWII; an Abraham Lincoln campaign token comes in on the night shift.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S06 E12 — Like a Rock
A 1955 Chevy pickup is brought to the shop; a guy pops in with a Smith & Wesson top break revolver; Rick and the Old Man are presented with a 1950s admiral's telephone from a U.S. Navy ship.

title: American Restoration
description:
S02 E15 — Anchors Away
A 1952 powerboat ride splashes into the shop; Rick tackles a 1940s child's tricycle for a Las Vegas museum.

title: Pawn Stars
description:
S09 E42 — Breaking the Bank
One of Dr. J's supposed game-worn sneakers steps into the shop. Find out if the guys score a slam dunk.

description: The government exploits the death of football star and soldier Pat Tillman for propaganda purposes.

description: Two dozen interviews with those who helped create and construct the Twin Towers, those who worked in them, and those who ultimately survived their terrible ending on 9/11.

description: Filmmaker Barbara Kopple examines a failed U.S. military operation to rescue hostages in Tehran, Iran, in 1980.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S01 E10 — Black Ops
Specially trained military elite perform top-secret operations using unconventional tactics to undertake the most dangerous missions on Earth.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S01 E08 — The FBI
Secret training, special operations, and amazing technology used by the FBI are exposed; most notorious agents; how the Internet age has changed law enforcement.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S01 E11 — The Pentagon
The epicenter of American military operations is exposed, including how secrets are protected, and how 9/11 compromised top-secret information within.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S01 E09 — West Point
The complex selection process, secret rituals and special training each cadet experiences at the renowned institution of West Point.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S02 E12 — Hell's Angels
The Hells Angels Motorcycle Club evolves from a small group of bikers into an organized crime syndicate.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S04 E04 — FBI vs. MLK
In 1962, Martin Luther King Jr. criticized Hoover's FBI for refusing to prosecute white supremacists who had burned down Black churches in Albany, Ga.; Hoover took King's criticisms as a personal insult, and he ordered the FBI to investigate King.

title: America's Book of Secrets
description:
S04 E08 — Mind Control
While it may sound like science fiction, numerous government-run mind control programs have been documented.
